## Research experience

::: {.cv-item}
[2018–2024]{.cv-date}

::: {}
**Doctoral Researcher**\
Brock University

Research focused on the behavioural ecology, reproductive behaviour, social organization, and population ecology of eastern carpenter bees (*Xylocopa virginica*).

- Four years of intensive field research
- Molecular ecology and microsatellite analyses
- Social-network analysis
- Longitudinal behavioural datasets
- Generalized linear and mixed-effects modelling
- Secured more than $60,000 in research funding
:::
:::

::: {.cv-item}
[2015–2018]{.cv-date}

::: {}
**Master's Researcher**\
Brock University

Research focused on behavioural interactions and social organization in eastern carpenter bees.

- DNA sequencing and molecular ecology
- Social-network analysis
- Behavioural observations
- Statistical modelling
- Secured more than $35,000 in research funding
:::
:::

::: {.cv-item}
[2014–2015]{.cv-date}

::: {}

Brandon University

Research on fungal diversity associated with ant mounds.

- Molecular techniques
- ITS barcoding
- Field ecology
- Community ecology
- Published peer-reviewed research
:::
